maintenanceAssessment: AND.40 unit 5 (PR A) changes only the two CI workflow files (ci.yml and security.yml) that the dependency policy binds. The maui job installs the pinned MAUI workloads, restores the NuGet closure with --locked-mode into a clean folder and builds the net10.0-android release app; setup-dotnet is pinned to the SHA the ArcForges family already uses. The publish-maui job publishes the MAUI prerelease from main only. No version changes: versions are the previous review's versions, and the Kotlin and Gradle inputs are unchanged until PR B.
